name: command-palette
purpose: Keyboard-first command search in a modal dialog, opened with Ctrl+K (Cmd+K on Apple platforms; configurable) or a button: a search field over a grouped, virtualized listbox driven by aria-activedescendant. Fuzzy matching highlights matched characters; sections for recent commands, command groups, and async providers (debounced and aborted on each keystroke) with a loading state; nested pages for commands with children (Backspace goes back); an Empty State when nothing matches; shortcuts shown with Kbd. Commands are plain data with an optional run callback.
whenToUse: Applications with many pages and actions where power users want to jump anywhere from the keyboard.
Global search that combines local commands with server results (people, records, documents).
whenNotToUse: As the only way to reach a feature: every command must also be reachable through visible navigation.
Choosing a value in a form: use Combobox or Select.
A short menu of actions for one object: use Menu or Context Menu.
responsive: The dialog is 40rem wide at most and never wider than the viewport minus a gutter; the result list grows with its content up to 24rem or 55% of the viewport height and then scrolls.
rtl: The field, results, and footer follow the writing direction; the back and submenu chevrons are mirrored.
theme: Component tokens command-palette-radius (radius-lg), -bg (color-surface), -shadow (shadow-lg), -backdrop (color-backdrop), and -option-radius (radius-sm). The active result uses color-selected and color-selected-text plus a start-edge bar; matches are semibold and underlined. Forced colors use Highlight and HighlightText.
security: Labels, descriptions, and section headers are rendered as text; matches are marked with <mark> elements built from text nodes. Commands run the application's own callbacks; provider results are validated before rendering.
dataHandling: Recent command ids are kept in memory only (read them from the recent property to persist them). No network access of its own; providers are the application's functions and receive an AbortSignal.

performance.testedScale: 10,000 commands with nested pages; at most 100,000 commands. maxResults (default 50) limits each section.

limitations: Rows have one height per density; long labels are truncated with an ellipsis.
Providers are searched at the top level only, not on nested pages.
The default shortcut Ctrl+K overrides the browser's search shortcut while the page has focus; set shortcut to another hotkey or null.
unsupported: Rich (HTML) labels or custom row renderers.
Several palettes listening to the same shortcut on one page.
antiPatterns: Commands that only exist in the palette (keep them discoverable in the visible UI).
Providers that ignore the AbortSignal and keep stale requests running.
